description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1976/31 of 22.07.2016 D/S Division, Kesbewa and Other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights, land parcel classifications, extent measurements, and village name corrections for various land parcels in the Colombo District. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned.
